title: Mom's Cozy Chair
can_do: 注意到大人的状态，主动问“你累吗、需要什么”，并用行动关心。

conversation_move.label: notice and ask how someone feels

trigger: Mom sits down slowly after a long day, and Child notices and asks about her.
setting: Early evening in the living room.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Mom, are you feeling tired today?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: A little, my dear. My legs are heavy.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Do you want to sit down and rest?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: I do, but dinner isn't started yet.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Dad can start dinner. I can bring your slippers!

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: You taking care of me? That's so sweet.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: You take care of me every day. Now it's my turn!

replay_cards.title: Dad's long day
replay_cards.setting: Dad comes home quiet and tired.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks how Dad feels, fetches his slippers, and suggests resting before dinner.

replay_cards.title: Max's dropped ice cream
replay_cards.change: Max drops his ice cream on the ground.
replay_cards.challenge: Child notices, asks how Max feels, and offers to share his own cone or buy a new one together.

parent_support: 大人偶尔真实示弱（累了、腿酸），给孩子关心你的机会。
孩子问候后认真回应感受，并接受他的照顾提议。
点破一句：“你注意到妈妈累了，这叫关心。”给行为命名。
